[SWS_PHM_01349]
{DRAFT}
Switch Elementary Supervision Status from
kFAILED
to
kOK
⌈
If the
Elementary Supervision Status
is
kFAILED
AND
there is no failure present in the
Alive Supervision
, i.e. the counter for failed Alive
Supervision reference cycles is zero, THEN the
Platform Health Management
shall change the
Elementary Supervision Status
to
kOK
.
⌋
(RS_PHM_00111)
See transition (5) in figure 7.5.
